title: South Karelia: 2.1 more lung cancer patients a year treated to cure, for €117,250 a year
markdown:
# South Karelia: 2.1 more lung cancer patients a year treated to cure, for €117,250 a year

> Closes 2.1 of 5.8 missing patients a year (36%) · €117,250 of €1M · €882,750 left: nothing more pays off on today's evidence

## The gap

Of 100 lung cancer patients in South Karelia, 19 get treatment that aims to cure. In Finland it is 27. That is about 6 patients a year. [^care_curative] Compared with the best quarter of counties, 8.1 patients a year are missing from treatment that aims to cure (range 5.0–11.0). [^care_curative] [^model] Compared with Finland as a whole, 0.0 fewer are operated and 5.8 fewer get radiotherapy that aims to cure. [^model] Part of this gap may be treatment that was given but not recorded: 42.8% have no treatment on record, against 27.5% in Finland. [^care_no_record] [^model]

## The target

Raise the share of lung cancer patients treated to cure from 18.9% to 21.9% by 2028: 2.1 more patients a year (range 0.0–3.4), for €117,250 a year, about €55,307 per extra patient. [^care_curative][^model] That closes 36% of the measured shortfall against Finland as a whole (5.8 patients a year). [^model]

## Funded actions

| # | Action and owner | Cost a year | More patients treated to cure a year (range) | First step this week | Measure: today → target |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| | **Step zero: fix the records (no direct effect)** | | | | |
| 0 | **Audit of treatment records ("no treatment on record")**[^ev_recording_audit_1]. Chief physician of oncology and the head of clinical coding | €8,000 | 0.0 | Pull 50 patients diagnosed in 2023 with no treatment on record and check their charts this month. | Share of patients with no treatment on record: 42.8% → 27.5% by 2027 |
| | **The county can start on Monday** | | | | |
| 1 | **Travel and accommodation support for patients far from the university hospital**[^ev_travel_accommodation_support_1]. Chief physician of oncology and hospital social work; university hospital patient hotel | €22,300 | 0.6 (0.0–1.0) | Name one contact person who books the patient hotel and transport for every patient sent to the university hospital for curative treatment. | Share of patients who get treatment that aims to cure: 18.9% → 19.8% by 2028 |
| 2 | **Stereotactic radiotherapy pathway for early cancer in patients who cannot be operated**[^ev_sbrt_pathway_1]. Chief physician of oncology; chief of radiotherapy at the university hospital | €16,200 | 0.6 (0.0–1.1) | Write the referral rule: every stage I patient not accepted for surgery is referred for stereotactic radiotherapy the same week. | Share of patients who get treatment that aims to cure: 18.9% → 19.7% by 2028 |
| 3 | **Fitness assessment and prehabilitation before deciding against curative treatment**[^ev_prehab_fitness_assessment_1]. Chief physician of pulmonology; leads of rehabilitation and geriatrics | €19,750 | 0.2 (0.0–0.2) | Decide that no stage I-III patient is recorded as "not fit" without an exercise test, and book the physiotherapy group. | Share of patients who get treatment that aims to cure: 18.9% → 19.2% by 2028 |
| | **Needs the collaborative area (university hospital)** | | | | |
| 4 | **Video MDT review of every stage I-III patient with the university hospital**[^ev_video_mdt_stage1_3_1]. Chief physician of pulmonology; lead of the university hospital lung MDT | €51,000 | 0.7 (0.0–1.0) | Ask the university hospital for a fixed weekly video slot and list every stage I-III patient diagnosed last month who was not discussed there. | Share of patients who get treatment that aims to cure: 18.9% → 20.0% by 2028 |
| | **Total** | **€117,250** | **2.1 (0.0–3.4)** | | |

No trial has measured these effects; the low end of every range is zero. The ranges do not add up to the range of the total, because the measures share one ceiling. Costs are assumptions. [^model]

## Needs a national decision (outside this budget)

- **Low-dose CT screening for long-term heavy smokers**[^ev_ldct_screening_1]: Ministry of Social Affairs and Health and Palko (decision), Finnish Cancer Registry (steering), county (delivery). €392,714 a year; modelled to avoid 0.7 deaths a year (0.1–1.7). Not counted in this budget. Not a county decision. Ask the Ministry and Palko for the timetable after the 2026-2028 pilot and offer the county as a pilot site. [^model]

## What to measure from Monday

- Share of patients treated to cure: 18.9% (2019–2023, measured) → 21.9% by 2028. [^care_curative][^model]
- Share of patients with no treatment on record: 42.8% → 27.5% by 2027. [^care_no_record][^model]
- The registry's public figures cover 2019–2023; count these each month from the county's own records. [^care_curative]

## What more money buys, and what it cannot

The remaining €882,750 buys nothing more in the model. [^model] €117,250 already buys every measure that adds patients treated to cure, and the limit is the part of the shortfall that can be reached, not money. [^model] Two other options remain: low-dose CT screening for long-term heavy smokers, which needs a national decision, or ranking measures by deaths avoided. [^model] About 58 people die of lung cancer a year in South Karelia, and this plan is modelled to avoid 0.3 of those deaths (range 0.0–1.0). [^deaths] [^model]

## Pilot ask

Pilot: South Karelia wellbeing services county + the HUS collaborative area, 6 months: (1) video MDT review of every stage I-III patient with the university hospital, (2) travel and accommodation support for patients far from the university hospital. KPI: share of patients treated to cure 18.9% → 21.9% by 2028. [^model]

## Limits

- The effect figures are assumptions, not trial results. Each range shows the lowest and highest values when all assumptions move together; it is not a probability. [^model]
- The expected share is adjusted only for the share of residents aged 65 or over, not stage, other illness, histology, smoking or how the cancer was found. County figures cannot show cause. [^model]
- 42.8% have no treatment on record, against 27.5% in Finland. Audit the records before reading the share treated to cure as a gap in care. [^care_no_record] [^model]
